egovframeBatCore.reason: collection batch seeds standardized batch variables into the ExecutionContext and gets lifecycle logging via bat-core EgovJobVariableListener/EgovStepVariableListener; Spring Batch JobRepository, restart, and idempotency semantics and job/step names stay unchanged. psl-dataaccess rides in only as bat-core's inert transitive (classpath-verified, never imported).

fdlLogging.constraint: do not import eGovFrame logging types outside backend support runtime verification

fdlProperty.constraint: Spring Boot configuration remains the source of truth; only operational parameters move to eGovFrame property in S3

fdlIdgnr.constraint: UUID, database IDs, receipt tokens, and security identifiers must not move to eGovFrame ID generation; S3 adopts it only for the operational collection run ID

pslDataaccess.constraint: current production persistence stays on Spring JDBC/JdbcTemplate and Flyway-managed schema

fdlAccess.constraint: admin/operator auth stays on Spring Security and does not cross token or crypto boundaries

fdlExcel.constraint: exports must prove memory, privacy, and CI cost before adding Excel-specific runtime dependencies; S4 adds xlsx alongside the unchanged CSV contract

mustNotDo: move mobile or public JSON contracts to eGovFrame types
replace token, crypto, receipt, or auth boundaries with eGovFrame starters
add remote-only eGovFrame dependencies without lockfile and local mirror evidence
